name: Gossamer_BossState
meaning: state field of Gossamer_Boss

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_RUN
meaning: SetState 0: anim RUN1, turn budget 0x1000; Update: ChaseStep (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_LIGHT
meaning: SetState 1: anim LIGHT looped; Update: on anim end turns around, -> 2 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_WALK_HOME
meaning: SetState 2: anim RUN2; Update: WalkHome, -> 6 at hitIndex 2 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_DEFEATED
meaning: set by Update 7; no Update case (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_STOP
meaning: SetState 4: anim STOP; Update: -> 0x12 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_WAIT
meaning: SetState 5: anim STAND1; Update: timer -> 0 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_FALL
meaning: SetState 6: anim RUN2; Update: falls from the phase box (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_BRIDGE
meaning: SetState 7: anim BRIDGE; Update: releases the Wolf and camera, -> 3 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_SPIN
meaning: SetState 8: anim TURN1, turn budget 0x3000; Update: TurnStep(9) (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_SPIN_ATTACK
meaning: SetState 9: anim TURN, phase timer, spin sound 0x3f (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_SPIN_END
meaning: SetState 0xa: anim TURN3; Update: -> 0 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_SMASH
meaning: SetState 0xb: MSG_WOLF_FORCE_STOW; Update: PUNCH then STAND3, MSG_WOLF_SQUASH (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_SHAKE
meaning: SetState 0xc: anim SHAKE; Update: onde shockwave (msg 0x6c) and camera shake (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_KICK
meaning: SetState 0xd: anim KICK; Update: -> 0xe (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_KICK2
meaning: SetState 0xe: anim KICK2, MSG_WOLF_SQUASH_LEAP within 100 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_PAUSE
meaning: Update 0xf: timer -> 0 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_GUARD
meaning: SetState 0x10: anim STAND1 2000 ms; Update: faces the Wolf, shakes or chases (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_CHASE_TARGET
meaning: SetState 0x11: anim RUN1; Update: MoveTo(chaseTarget) (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_RETURN_HOME
meaning: SetState 0x12: anim RUN1; Update: MoveTo(homePos) (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_BRIDGE_HIT
meaning: SetState 0x13: anim TURN3; Update: hitBody BRIDGE1, -> 1 (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_TAUNT
meaning: SetState 0x14: anim STAND1, 5000 ms; Update: faces the Wolf until he stops running (inferred)

name: GOSSBOSS_ST_EXIT
meaning: Update 0x15: in the exit box sets g_gameFlags 0x10000 and reveals the buttons (inferred)
